sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the minor maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed 
every ten years as indicated by Y10 in the above title block.

Condition of CB During Work: 1- Circuit breaker out of service and must 
be isolated.

2- Gas compartments need not 
be opened.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah kamel 
Mostafa (HV-Dep. Manager), 
tested by eng. 
Sahar Mahamed Ali, accepted by electrical general director eng. Said 
Mahmoud Hessain 
Farag, 
revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control engineer Adel Abdel Kader El-Naggar, and approved by eng.
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady; head sector of Ataka PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 stuff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety belts 
 ... etc.

sections.text:
Measure of the N2 Priming Pressure on the Oil Side as 
Follows:

items:
Connect the precision pressure gauge (class 0.6) to the measuring 
 connection.
M2 (fig. 6) of the control unit with the oil un pressurized.
Close the pressure release valve 14.37 (fig. 6).

Switch on the oil pump. Shortly after the oil pump has been switch on , the 
 pointer jump to the priming pressure value.

If the priming pressure is more than 5 bar below the tolerance, the N2 
 filling should be corrected.

The gas side of the hydraulic reservoir may only be filled with (N2 purity 
 99.99%, O2 content less than 50ppm, H2 O content 30 ppm).
No other gases may be used for the hydraulic reservoir.

Owing to the permissible leak rate of approximately (2-5)bar the priming 
 pressure can drop below the nominal filling pressure during the operating 
 period . for example :- circuit breaker has been in operation for 5 years, 
 check of the priming pressure in the storage unit shows a measurement of 183 
 bar.

The permissible leakage rate has not been exceed ed. even if the priming 
 pressure deviates.

For filling in the N2 gas a pump set is required whet can be bought or 
 borrowed from the erecting department (ANL.A4)in erlangen (fig. 7).

sections.text:
Check of the Opening and Closing Pressure of the Safety 
Valve

items:
Operate contactor K9 in the control cubical (fig. 
 5) electrically.

The oil pump increases the oil pressure in the 
 hydraulic system beyond the nominal pressure.

The safety valve operate and passes the oil from 
 the high pressure section to the un pressurized part of hydraulic system.

The operating pressure must be between (375 412) 
 bar.

When the pump switched off, determine the closing 
 pressure of the safety valve (the closing value must be at least 10 bar above 
 the upper pump on value (320 bar ) approx.

If the pressure values are out side these limits , 
 anew safety valve must be used . The breaker must not be put into 
 operation before this has been done . The new safety valve must be the same 
 type as the old one.

sections.text:
Check the Inner Sealing of the Hydraulic System in both 
Switching States

items:
The measurement should be made with the circuit 
 breaker in the "on" and "off" position and the hydraulic system at nominal 
 pressure (320bar)

Measure the oil pressure by using the precision 
 pressure gauge and repeat the measurement after 30 minutes with the pump 
 switched off and after the temperature has reached an adequate level (approx. 
 15 minutes ) . the leakage rate must not exceed 5 bar/ hour. Temperature 
 variation accruing during the measurements must be allowed for with approx. 
 1bar.

sections.text:
Check the Operating values of the SF6 Density Monitor and 
Oil Pressure Monitor
SF6 Density Monitor Operating Values Check

items:
to Determine the operating values of the SF6 density monitor follow 
 these procedures:

Connect the SF6 gas to the maintenance flange w1 
 through a distributor with t drain value fixed on it a precision SF6 pressure 
 gauge class 0.6 (0-10) bar and a safety valve as show in (fig. 1).

Open the drain valve of the distributor to reduce the SF6 pressure of the 
 circuit breaker.

Read and record the values of the precision gauge at which the sf6 density 
 monitor function (alarm, lock out) during the pressure density process.

Close of the distributor drain valve and open SF6 cylinder regulator valve to 
 the increase the sf6 pressure inside the circuit breaker.

Read and record during this process value of the values of the precision gauge 
 at which the sf6 lock out and alarm are cleared.

sections.text: Oil Pressure Monitor Operating Value Check

items:
Open the pressure release valve 14.37( fig. 6 )to unpressurized the 
 hydraulic circuit (for this switch off the out pump CB).
Connect the test pressure gauge to M2 .

Close the valve 14.37 again and switch on the oil pump to bring the system to 
 the nominal pressure.

Reduce the pressure with the valve 14.37 and chick the operating values of the 
 pressure switch using the pressure monitor (see section 1-0080under technical 
 data).

sections.text:
Check of Breaker Pressure Gauge 
 of SF6 and Pressurized Oil

items:
The difference between the measured values of the 
 test pressure gauge (class 0.6 ) and the service pressure gauge (class1.0 ) 
 must not be larger than the sum of the permissible deviation `1of the two 
 pressure gauges .

This means that the deviation of the `test 
 pressure gauge of (class 1.0) with measuring range of 600bar (oil ) or 15 bar 
 (gas ) with respect to the service pressure gauge must not be larger than 12 
 bar (oil ) or 0.3 bar (gas )

Deviation above 5 bar (oil ) and 0.2 bar (sf6 ) 
 should be noted on the service pressure gauge (by hand on adhesive film)

sections.text: Check of the Heating Effect of the Anti Condensation Heater

items:
Check the function of the external monitoring circuit , if provided , for the 
 anti condensation heating

If this heating is not monitored, the current consumption 
 should be measured .

sections.text:
Check of the Release Circuit Enforced Triple Poles 
Operation, anti pumping Feature and Lockouts.
Auto Recluse Lockout

items: Switch off the pump motor by tripping CB.

Lower the storage pressure by means the pressure 
 release valve 14.37 (fig.6) until pressure monitor B2 (fig. 6) activates 
 the auto reclose lock out via contactor K4 (in the control unit).

Read off the operating pressure on the test 
 pressure gauge (precision gauge ).

Check the indication and effectiveness of the auto 
 reclose lockout feature.

sections.text: Reclosing Lockout

items:
Slowly reduce the storage pressure further until 
 the pressure monitor B2 (fig. 6) and contactor K2 (in the control unit) 
 operate.

Read off the operating pressure on the test 
 precision pressure gauge.

Check the indication and effectiveness of the auto 
 reclose lockout by means of electrical "on" command, the breaker must not 
 be close .

sections.text: Function Lockout

items:
Switch on the pump motor and increase the pressure 
 until the reclosing lockout is cancelled
Close the breaker and switch off the pump motor .

Slowly increase the storage pressure until 
 pressure monitor B2 and contactor K3 operate.

Read off the operating pressure gauge ( see 
 technical dada ) on the test pressure gauge .

Check the indication and effectiveness of the 
 function lockout by means of electrical "off" commands in all tripping paths
The breaker must not open.

sections.text: Enforced Triple Pole Operation Feature (only Version E)
Breaker with Separate Hydraulic Operating System

items:
Close all three poles of the breaker and open one 
 of them by actuating the operating trip Y2 (fig.3)

After the time set on enforced triple poles 
 operation relay on the plant side has elapsed , the other two poles must also 
 be tripped by enforced triple- pole operation contactor .

Carry out this test in the similar manner on the 
 other two poles.

Close one breaker pole by manually actuating the 
 closing coilY1 (fig.3)

When the reset time has elapsed , the pole must 
 reopen .

This check should be carried out on al three 
 poles.

sections.text: Tripping

Check the tripping action of the circuit breaker 
 via all the existing tripping paths.
Anti Pumping Feature
Breaker in "Open "State

items:
Give" close "command and keep button pressed in 
 (maintained command).

Give "open" command while the close command is 
 being applied.

Breaker may only close and then open; it must not 
 reclose despite the presence of the close command .

sections.text: Breaker in "Close" State

items:
Give close command and keep button pressed in 
 (maintained command).

Give open command after approximate 15 s while the 
 close command is being applied.
Breaker may only open (must be reclose)

sections.text: Delayed Function lockout on N2 Loss

items:
The time relay is set in the factory to a 
 reference delay time of three hours.
Check the time setting and correct if necessary.

Any deviation time settings require an agreement 
 between the customer, the sales department and the manufacture.

Check for corrosion protection and touch up where 
 necessary.
Check the paint finish of the circuit breaker for damage.
Defective parts must be derusted provided a priming coat and varnished.
